newsitem.title: USA: HP, Cisco in computing alliance.
newsitem.headline: HP, Cisco in computing alliance.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co and Cisco Systems Inc Wednesday said they will jointly develop Internet-ready networked-computing solutions to maximize the benefits of combining networking and computing.
HP and Cisco said they will expand or begin collaboration in four areas: technology development, product integration, professional services and customer service and support.

"An integrated information infrastructure is mandatory for today's enterprises to deploy rapidly emerging Internet and intranet technologies -- electronic-commerce applications being the most pervasive," said Lewis E. Platt, chairman, president and chief executive officer of HP.
In a statement, HP and Cisco said they have worked together for many years, and today's announcement broadens the scope of collaboration between the two industry leaders.

The companies said they will offer end-to-end solutions for Microsoft Windows NT and UNIX system environments, with an emphasis on one-stop service and support. Efforts will focus on critical business applications, such as intranets, electronic commerce, databases and messaging.
